settings.heading: No file? No problem.
settings.body: Product design support takes ideas and sketches to printable models — describing the problem is enough to start.

settings.heading: Honest feasibility, first.
settings.body: If a part isn't a good fit for FDM printing in PLA or PETG, we'll tell you before any money changes hands.

settings.heading: One part or a repeat run.
settings.body: One-off prototypes and repeat production runs are equally welcome — scope shapes the approach, never the attention.

settings.heading: Tell us what you're making.
settings.intro: Share what you can — we'll come back with questions, options, and a price. A sketch is enough to start, and a quote is a conversation, not a contract.
settings.step1_body: And reply with any questions — a real person, not an automated estimate.
settings.step2_body: Price, material, and timeline, with the reasoning behind each.
settings.step3_title: Approve it, and we start making
settings.step3_body: Prototyped, printed, and inspected before it's prepared for delivery.
settings.helpful_lines:
What you're making, and roughly how many
Your timeline, if you have one
How the part will be used
Anything else we should know
